workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.languageDescription: The default interface language for members who have not chosen their own, and the language employees write in when their output language is set to “Workspace default”.
workspace.timezoneDescription: Used for project deadlines and health, and other dates of this workspace.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Guards are on by default: prompt-injection screening on tool results and secret/PII leakage checks on outputs.
safety.guardsDisableConfirm: Disable guards? This is not recommended.
safety.demoModeHint: Scripted runs with zero tokens and no network calls; same SSE events.
safety.require2fa: Require two-factor authentication for Owners and Admins
safety.require2faHint: They must set up an authenticator app before they can use the workspace. Only an Owner can change this.
safety.require2faDisableConfirm: Stop requiring two-factor authentication for Owners and Admins?

claude.title: Claude credential
claude.description: Each workspace uses its own credential. A run receives only this workspace's credential, only while it runs. Subscription tokens come from claude setup-token.

email.description: Used for send_email / send_invoice and notifications. The password never leaves the server.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: When approvals are waiting or a task finishes.
notifications.webhookHelp: The webhook receives JSON {payload}. It is also the target of the irreversible post_webhook tool.

integrations.title: MCP servers
integrations.description: Connect remote (Streamable HTTP) MCP servers. Tokens are encrypted and never sent to the browser or the model. Grant a server per employee as {grant}; its tools are classified by verb (read/list/search = reversible, anything else = irreversible → approval).

pricing.title: Published price table
pricing.description: 1 credit = {usd}. Every LLM step is charged from this table, so you can forecast cost before running.

members.title: Members
members.description: Owner: everything incl. allow-lists & pricing · Admin: employees, approvals, settings · Member: tasks, chat, clients · Viewer: read-only.
members.createdPrompt: User created. Share this one-time password securely:
members.resetPrompt: New one-time password (they must change it at next sign-in). Share it securely:
members.resetConfirm: Reset the password for {email}? Their current password and sessions stop working.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Immutable (append-only, enforced by a database trigger): approvals, permission changes, credential changes, kill-switch use.

repositories.title: Git repositories
repositories.description: Workspace-mode employees work on these repositories in their sandbox. The platform clones, pushes and opens pull requests with the token; employees never see it.
repositories.tokenHelp: Needed for private repositories, pushing and pull requests. Use a fine-grained token limited to this repository (contents + pull requests). Stored encrypted; only its last 4 characters are shown.
